name: WordsAPI
tagline: Word definitions, synonyms, rhymes, and frequency data for English vocabulary.
description: WordsAPI provides dictionary and lexical data for English words including definitions, synonyms, antonyms, rhymes, pronunciation, frequency, and related word forms via a REST API. It is commonly used for language tools, education apps, word games, and NLP features that need structured lexical lookup rather than full NLP pipelines.

auth.details: API key via RapidAPI headers (X-RapidAPI-Key and X-RapidAPI-Host); self-serve signup on RapidAPI.

pricing.free_tier_limits: 2,500 requests/day on RapidAPI BASIC free plan (soft limit; overage $0.004/request)
pricing.paid_plans: Paid tiers via RapidAPI; exact limits not verified in this pass

rate_limits: BASIC free: 2,500/day soft (+$0.004 overage); Pro: 25,000/day soft; Ultra: 250,000/day soft; Mega: 500,000/day soft (RapidAPI daily quotas)
use_cases: look up definitions and part of speech for a word
get synonyms or antonyms for thesaurus features
find rhyming words for poetry or games
retrieve word frequency or pronunciation data
